# CarFixCosts
# Real Auto Repair Costs — By City & Repair
# https://carfixcosts.com

## About
CarFixCosts provides BLS-adjusted auto repair cost data for 14 common repairs across 161 US cities. Pricing reflects real mechanic and dealership rates adjusted for local cost of living.

## Data Type
auto repair costs, car repair estimates, mechanic pricing by city

## Coverage
161 US cities including: New York, NY, Los Angeles, CA, Chicago, IL, Houston, TX, Phoenix, AZ, Philadelphia, PA, San Antonio, TX, San Diego, CA and 153 more.

## Update Frequency
Quarterly — last updated March 2026

## Methodology
All cost estimates are calculated using Bureau of Labor Statistics Regional Price Parity indices applied to national baseline data from verified industry sources. Full methodology: https://carfixcosts.com/methodology
